title: Omega
subtitle: Close Your Eyes and Focus
text: Action [1 resource, Exhaust]: Attack with a Heroism unit. It gains Grit for this attack. (It gets +1/+0 for each damage on it.)
deployBox: Other friendly Heroism units gain Grit.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules: If you use Omega’s leader ability, you must attack with a unit, if able. Units must be ready in order to attack.
